service.en: Issue an economic licence: Tajer Abu Dhabi
service.ur: اقتصادی لائسنس کا اجرا: تاجر ابوظہبی

about: Get a Tajer Abu Dhabi licence for set commercial activities without a physical establishment site, valid for 3 years.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Only for specific commercial activities with no official establishment site
The licence includes a standard memorandum of association
fees: 790 AED organisational entities fee, plus 100 AED for each activity after the sixth
300 AED Abu Dhabi Chamber membership fee
The page also lists company-only fees: 1,500 AED social contribution and 2,500 AED Ministry of Economy fee
timing: You get an approval or rejection notice
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
